english.note: Use this when you specifically mean a deep cooking pan with a long handle, rather than an ordinary pot.

examples.english: When I make sauce, I use a long-handled saucepan because it is easier to stir.
examples.traditional: 煮醬汁嗰陣，我會用長柄煲，方便啲攪拌。
